EXPTRACK 1.6.0

Install EXPTRACK-1.6.0.apk over your existing app; do not uninstall.

Config now supports 1-6 daily spending reminders with a separate time for each. Choose the count and times, then Save reminder times. Switch reminders on/off from the same section. Times follow the phone local time. Notification permission is required; Android battery restrictions can delay delivery.

Also includes compact month selection, aligned bottom navigation, and sync status only in Config. Records and login are preserved when updating.
